typography.guidelines: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1-H3 headings. Ensure headings use tight tracking (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`). Use Manrope for body text with loose line-height (`leading-relaxed`). Use uppercase with wide tracking (`tracking-widest`) for overlines, categories, and small labels.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Use delicate borders to define premium cards or section divisions.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle, diffuse ambient shadows. Example: `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]`.
visual_enhancers.corners: Subtle rounded corners. Use `rounded-md` or `rounded-lg` max (4px to 8px). Avoid excessive rounding.
visual_enhancers.textures: Consider a subtle grain texture overlay on dark sections or the hero background to avoid flat color.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for the sticky navigation and floating mobile bar. Must have a backdrop blur (`backdrop-blur-xl`), semi-transparent background (`bg-white/80`), and a delicate 1px border.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing is critical for an award-worthy feel. Use 2-3x typical spacing. Sections should have `py-20` to `py-32`. Elements inside should use `gap-8` to `gap-16`.
layouts.grid: Embrace asymmetry. For the 'About' section, use a split-screen (e.g., 50/50 or 40/60). For 'Gallery' and 'Instagram', use dense or masonry layouts.
layouts.hero: Full height (`min-h-[90vh]` or `100vh`). Masked kinetic text reveal. High impact, large typography.
layouts.general: Avoid standard centered Bootstrap columns. Embrace whitespace. Rely on optical alignment.

motion.scrolling: Lenis MUST be implemented for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion for line-by-line text masks, staggered fade-in-up for cards and images on scroll.
motion.hero: On-load masked line-by-line reveal for 'Your Look. Your Style. Your Confidence.' + subtle slow scale (parallax) on the hero background image.
motion.marquee: One slow editorial marquee with a Serif font, widely spaced. Implement using `react-fast-marquee`.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on service cards (subtle scale-up `scale-[1.02]`), buttons (background color shift, slight transform).

components.navigation: Sticky top nav. Glassmorphism effect. Includes Logo, links, and 'Book Appointment' CTA. DO NOT use a completely transparent background.
components.hero: Full-width background image with overlay (e.g., `bg-black/30`), kinetic typography, rating badge (4.8/5), primary CTAs.
components.about: Split-screen layout. Large image on one side (clipped frame or organic shape), sophisticated typography on the other. Include numbered manifesto chapters.
components.services: 6 distinct categories (Hair, Hair Colour, Skin & Facials, Nails, Makeup, Grooming). Premium card design. Each displays name/description/duration/price/'Book Now'. Clicking 'Book Now' opens the Booking Modal.
components.booking_modal: Use Shadcn Dialog. Pre-selects the clicked service. Frontend-only form. Show a success state after submission.
components.marquee: Slow moving, elegant text ribbon. E.g., 'MORE THAN JUST A SALON • ELEVATE YOUR STYLE • REVEAL YOUR CONFIDENCE •'
components.reviews: Clean, elegant review cards. Highlight the 4.8/5 rating.
components.instagram: Grid of square images (Follow Our Work).
components.contact: Contact details paired with a map placeholder.
components.floating_whatsapp: Floating WhatsApp button (`fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50`) on desktop.
components.mobile_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile view ONLY containing: Call | WhatsApp | Book.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure a 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast ratio. Text placed over images MUST have a gradient overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, modals, menu items) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

hero_background.description: Premium modern hair salon interior with stylist

instructions_to_main_agent: Honor the client's art direction: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level. Use bold editorial design, oversized serif headings, and generous whitespace.
Implement Framer Motion for section reveals, particularly the kinetic line-by-line text mask in the Hero section.
Set up Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is mandatory for the premium feel.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for the sticky nav. Use a strong glassmorphism effect (blur + white/80).
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (checkmarks, arrows, WhatsApp, phone, etc.).
Ensure 'Book Now' opens a modal (Shadcn Dialog) to book the selected service with a frontend-only success state.
Implement a mobile-only fixed bottom bar (Call | WhatsApp | Book). Hide this on md+ breakpoints.
Build the configuration object (centralized config for salon name/logo/tagline/services/brand colors) in a dedicated configuration file and import it where needed.
Do not use generic SaaS layouts. Rely on asymmetric, editorial, masonry, or bento grids.
Apply data-testid on every clickable or actionable element.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Avoid universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions for specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS. Keep natural reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Use the provided URLs.
Prioritize Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dialog, Forms, Select).
